en.headline: About 200 evacuated after scaffolding fire at Tuen Mun industrial building
en.dek: Police and firefighters responded to a blaze on exterior scaffolding at an industrial building on Kin Fat Lane shortly after 2pm, with no injuries reported.
body: Police and the Fire Services Department responded to multiple reports of a fire on exterior scaffolding at an industrial building in Tuen Mun shortly after 2pm on Saturday.
Officers said the blaze occurred at No 2 Kin Fat Lane. Firefighters deployed a hose line and a breathing apparatus team to tackle the flames. About 200 people were evacuated from the building.
No injuries had been reported as of mid-afternoon, and an investigation into the cause was under way. The fire was brought under control within about half an hour.
The incident took place while a Red Fire Danger Warning remained in force across Hong Kong, indicating extreme fire risk amid very dry conditions.

zh.headline: 屯門工廈外牆棚架起火 約200人疏散
zh.dek: 警方及消防於下午2時許接報建發里工廈外牆棚架起火，疏散約200人，暫無受傷報告。
body: 警方及消防處周六下午2時許接獲多個報案，指屯門一工廈外牆棚架起火。
警方表示，火警發生於建發里2號。消防出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊撲救，並疏散約200人。
截至下午中段暫無受傷報告，起火原因有待調查。火勢約半小時後大致救熄。
事件發生時，紅色火災危險警告仍在生效，天文台表示火災危險性極高。
